$comment: Sign-in surfaces: /login, the shared-device QR sign-in (iPad side and phone approval page /qr/<code>), and /auth-error.
signInSubtitle: Sign in to access the music library
jsRequired: Sign-in requires JavaScript. Please enable it in your browser settings to continue.
authorizedOnly: Only authorized accounts can access the full library.
signInIncomplete: Sign-in didn't complete. Check your connection and try again. If this keeps happening, clear cookies for this site and retry.
setUpDevice: Set up this device — sign in with phone
qrScanHint: Scan with your phone to sign in
approveExpiredBody: This {orgName} sign-in code expired or was already used. Ask for a fresh QR code on the device you’re signing in to.
approveSignedInBody: The iPad is now signed in as {userName}. You can close this page.
approveSignInPrompt: Sign in with your Google account to continue on the nearby device.
approveTapToSignInAs: Tap below to sign in as {userName} on the nearby device.
authErrorBody: We detected an issue with your login session that was causing a redirect loop. This usually happens when your browser's cached data gets out of sync with the server.
authErrorHint: Clicking the button below will securely clear your local session and let you log in fresh.
